subject.title: feat: roll out state publication batching

question: Should the repository enable this member-authored production batching rollout after a maintainer confirms live dispatch, reservation clearing, and rollback behavior?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes operational defaults and workflow admission; tests and local synthetic proof reduce risk but cannot choose the acceptable production rollout posture.

options.title: Approve controlled size-two rollout
options.body: Merge after a maintainer verifies the deployed dashboard configuration and confirms one real dispatched batch clears its reservation and publishes correctly.

options.title: Pause at default-off batching
options.body: Keep the existing merged batching implementation disabled until maintainers want additional live operational evidence before changing admission behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve controlled size-two rollout
recommendation.body: Merge after a maintainer verifies the deployed dashboard configuration and confirms one real dispatched batch clears its reservation and publishes correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository-member proposer of this rollout and the most directly identified person for the deployment context.
